name: Exp Solar
description: Reference-documentary editing style built on the existing Overscaled renderer: same fixed-canvas whiteboard-collage mechanics (nodes, layout, Ken Burns, hand-drawn arrows), tuned toward restrained arrow usage and a hero/supporting rhythm, plus a 4-in-a-row composition for the reference's transitional beat (beat=four_row). Does not yet add the 3x5 index/checklist layouts or sound design; those are later Exp Solar phases and fall back to Overscaled's existing behavior for now.

arrows.notes: Exp Solar CSV-generation rule: default is NO arrow — only draw one for a stated causal/dependency/consequence/transformation/mechanism relationship, never for mere adjacency. default_color (red) stays reserved for the rare kind='callout' proof relationship; alt_color (black) is the default 'sequential' connector. Enforced at CSV-generation time, not by this renderer.

camera.notes: The camera never moves; automatic per-node Ken Burns (scene_graph.routing.deterministic_unit -> layout.node_ken_burns -> FFmpeg zoompan) is reused unchanged. camera_action/camera_target remain accepted for CSV compatibility but stay inert, exactly as in Overscaled.

metadata.max_active_per_chapter_notes: Read by scene_graph.pipeline.run_overscaled_pipeline and threaded into scene_graph.layout.compute_layout's max_active_per_chapter param, ONLY for this preset. Overscaled's own preset carries no such key, so compute_layout's default (module MAX_ACTIVE_PER_CHAPTER=3) still applies there, unchanged. Raising this beyond 4 would KeyError (only 1/2/3/4-slot templates exist).
